name: boxbox
description: Developer-in-control agentic coding: plan, decide with context, build one tested unit at a time, review each with a teaching report.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, decide, build and review with the developer in control
interface.longDescription: Boxbox splits work into milestones, epics and tasks, asks the developer for decisions with full context, builds one small tested unit at a time, and stops after each with a report that teaches what was built.
defaultPrompt: Let's add a feature to this project.
